+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+
+
+out = Path("out")
+out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+df = duckdb.connect().execute(
+    """
+    SELECT
+        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INT AS year,
+        COUNT(*)::INT AS reported_crashes,
+        SUM(number_of_motorist_killed)::INT AS motorist_deaths,
+        SUM(number_of_motorist_killed)::DOUBLE / COUNT(*) * 100000
+            AS motorist_deaths_per_100k_crashes
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """,
+    ["data/crashes.parquet"],
+).df()
+
+df.to_csv(out / "values_1.csv", index=False, columns=["year", "motorist_deaths"])
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+ax.plot(df.year, df.motorist_deaths, marker="o", color="#235789", linewidth=2.5)
+ax.set(
+    title="NYC motorist deaths in reported crashes, 2013–2025",
+    xlabel="Crash year",
+    ylabel="Motorists killed (count)",
+)
+ax.set_xticks(df.year)
+ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.annotate("110", (2013, 110), xytext=(0, 9), textcoords="offset points", ha="center")
+ax.annotate("81", (2025, 81), xytext=(0, 9), textcoords="offset points", ha="center")
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(out / "option_1.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+df.to_csv(
+    out / "values_2.csv",
+    index=False,
+    columns=[
+        "year",
+        "reported_crashes",
+        "motorist_deaths",
+        "motorist_deaths_per_100k_crashes",
+    ],
+)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+ax.plot(
+    df.year,
+    df.motorist_deaths_per_100k_crashes,
+    marker="o",
+    color="#c44536",
+    linewidth=2.5,
+)
+ax.set(
+    title="Motorist deaths per 100,000 reported NYC crashes, 2013–2025",
+    xlabel="Crash year",
+    ylabel="Motorist deaths per 100,000 reported crashes",
+)
+ax.set_xticks(df.year)
+ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+first, last = df.iloc[0], df.iloc[-1]
+ax.annotate(
+    f"{first.motorist_deaths_per_100k_crashes:.1f}",
+    (first.year, first.motorist_deaths_per_100k_crashes),
+    xytext=(0, 9),
+    textcoords="offset points",
+    ha="center",
+)
+ax.annotate(
+    f"{last.motorist_deaths_per_100k_crashes:.1f}",
+    (last.year, last.motorist_deaths_per_100k_crashes),
+    xytext=(0, 9),
+    textcoords="offset points",
+    ha="center",
+)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(out / "option_2.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+print(df.to_string(index=False))
*** End Patch
